purpose: Research-only evidence packet for five individually registered Dublin City NIAH buildings

official_dataset_reference.title: NIAH Data Download
official_dataset_reference.note: The official national CSV provides ITM, latitude and longitude location fields. Individual NIAH page coordinate pairs are retained separately as raw values because the pages do not state their CRS.

candidate_records.name: Avondale Bed and Breakfast
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010194 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced two-bay four-storey house over raised basement, built c.1820, with three-storey extension rising from original two-storey return. Built as one of a pair; NIAH says the pair are now used as a guesthouse and interconnected. Yellow Flemish-bond brick on granite plinth, Ionic doorcase, replacement aluminium windows, shared granite platform, cast-iron boot-scrape, six granite steps and decorative railings. NIAH appraisal describes a former Georgian townhouse that retains its overall composition despite loss of original fenestration.

candidate_records.name: Holyhead Accommodation
candidate_records.address: 42 Gardiner Street Lower / Talbot Street, Dublin 1, Ireland
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010195 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Corner-sited end-of-terrace three-bay three-storey house over raised basement, built c.1830, with a single-bay south side elevation and pair of shopfronts inserted at ground floor. Hipped slate roofs behind parapets with granite coping, yellow Flemish-bond brick on painted granite plinth, gauged brick openings, early replacement timber sliding sashes, Ionic doorcase, granite platform and six steps with wrought-iron railings. The south elevation has two inserted shopfronts. NIAH appraisal says the roof configuration suggests the building may originally have comprised two separate houses amalgamated in the late nineteenth century; this is a source interpretation, not grounds to split the current registered record.

candidate_records.name: 7 Mayor Street
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010196 present in Dublin missing-registration queue; queue NAME field is blank, and the official individual NIAH page title supplies the name.
candidate_records.research_notes: Detached two-storey three-bay house, built c.1890, with gabled end-bays to east of front and rear elevations. Pitched slate roof, red brick Flemish-bond walls, yellow brick platbands and red/yellow brick plinth course with black brick coping. Chamfered masonry lintels and sills, gauged yellow brick arches, paired windows to gabled end-bay, front dormer, timber-framed windows, timber bargeboards and clay chimney pots. NIAH appraisal identifies the house as a modest Victorian domestic building in a predominantly industrial area, retaining much of its original form and fabric.

candidate_records.name: Desmonds / Not to Worry / Talbot Street Business Centre
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010197 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced three-bay three-storey house, built c.1840, now in combined commercial and domestic use according to NIAH survey. Hipped slate roof with gutter valleys, shared brown-brick chimneystacks behind parapet, Flemish-bond upper brickwork, gauged square-headed windows and two-over-two timber sliding sash windows. Three-centred-arch entrance with moulded masonry surround and painted Ionic doorcase; recent shopfronts flank the entrance. Appraisal notes altered ground floor but survival of original form and fabric including the doorcase and sash windows, and its contribution to the north-side Talbot Street terrace.

candidate_records.name: Polski Sklep / Pawn Shop / Tattoo Energy / E Max Barbers
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010198 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced three-bay three-storey house, built c.1840, now in commercial use. Hipped slate roof with valley, shared brown-brick chimneystacks behind brown-brick parapet, Flemish-bond upper walls, gauged square-headed windows, masonry sills and replacement uPVC windows; recent tiled shopfronts flank a central square-headed door opening. Appraisal notes that although recent shopfronts have altered the building, its upper-floor form and subtle symmetry remain, contributing to the north-side Talbot Street terrace laid out in the 1840s following sale of Tyrone House.

duplicate_screen.method: Exact registration-number searches against open repository issues and pull requests.
duplicate_screen.result: No open issue or pull request matches returned for any of the five exact registration numbers at time of research.

identity_and_spatial_cautions: No.41 (50010194) and No.42 (50010195) are adjacent separately registered records. The NIAH identifies No.41 as built as one of a pair and interconnected; verify the pair identity through its own record before formal relationship linking. Do not merge the two registrations.

No.42 (50010195) is corner-sited and has a Talbot Street elevation with two inserted shopfronts. NIAH's suggestion that it may have originated as two houses amalgamated in the late nineteenth century is an appraisal interpretation, not evidence to create two current archive objects.

No.7 Mayor Street (50010196) is geographically separate from the Gardiner/Talbot Street group. Its official page coordinate pair differs greatly from the national CSV ITM/lat-long location; retain both source formats independently and investigate this discrepancy before any spatial import. Do not infer the page pair's CRS.

Nos.18 and 19 Talbot Street (50010198 and 50010197) are separately registered terrace buildings. Their shared chimney-stack descriptions and continuous terrace context do not justify merging them or creating separate chimney objects without independent evidence.
NIAH current-use and condition descriptions are survey-time source statements, not present-day field verification. No access, ownership, public access or current condition has been verified.
